snippet.title: Odd Shop - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late. 

Wishlist ODD SHOP on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5104470/Odd_Shop/
